rationale: PMC3993908 Results and Discussion and Extraction and Isolation identify radicicol and pochonin compounds 1-7 from Humicola fuscoatra UCSC108111A. Geldanamycin is a structurally unrelated HSP90 inhibitor used in the assay comparison, not a reported fungal isolate. Withhold only this unsupported triple; do not infer universal fungal absence or change producer claims. See issue #966.

Xue et al. 1998 (PMID:9770448, DOI:10.1073/pnas.95.21.12111) exclusively studies the pikromycin/methymycin/desosamine biosynthetic gene cluster of Streptomyces venezuelae ATCC 15439 and contains zero mention of Streptomyces narbonensis (NCBITaxon:67333); the LOTUS triple is an upstream cross-species propagation artifact from MIBiG BGC0000899. Withhold only this unsupported occurrence triple; do not infer absence of narbomycin/desosamine in S. narbonensis under other references or alter producer claims. See issue #1011.
